description: Implementation of (2^1+,2) cuckoo hashing, including functions for search, insert, delete, resize, and hash/key comparison methods specific to cuckoo hash table management.

methods.name: ckh_bucket_search
methods.description: Search a specific bucket for a key, return cell index or SIZE_T_MAX if not found.

methods.name: ckh_isearch
methods.description: Search entire table for a key, return cell index or SIZE_T_MAX if not found.

methods.name: ckh_try_bucket_insert
methods.description: Attempt to insert key/data into a specific bucket, return false if successful, true if full.

methods.name: ckh_evict_reloc_insert
methods.description: Evict and relocate items to insert a new key/data, detect cycles to prevent infinite loops.

methods.name: ckh_try_insert
methods.description: Attempt to insert key/data, with eviction/relocation if needed.

methods.name: ckh_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuild hash table from existing entries, used during resizing.

methods.name: ckh_grow
methods.description: Increase table size and rebuild to accommodate more entries.

methods.name: ckh_shrink
methods.description: Reduce table size when underutilized, with rebuild.

methods.name: ckh_new
methods.description: Initialize a new cuckoo hash table with minimum items, hash functions, and key comparison functions.

methods.name: ckh_count
methods.description: Return number of entries in the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_iter
methods.description: Iterate over entries in the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_insert
methods.description: Insert a key/data pair into the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_remove
methods.description: Remove a key from the hash table, returning key/data if found.

methods.name: ckh_search
methods.description: Search for a key in the hash table.
